atAGlance: Cơm gà Hội An is Hội An chicken rice: turmeric-tinted rice, shredded or chopped chicken, herbs, onion, chili-lime seasoning, and often a small side broth.
whatItIs: Cơm gà Hội An is Hội An chicken rice with turmeric-tinted rice, chicken, herbs, onion, and a bright chili-lime seasoning. The rice is as important as the chicken.
howToEnjoy: Mix some herbs and onion through the rice, then add chili-lime seasoning carefully. Ask for less chili if you want the chicken and rice to stay gentle.
howLocalsOrder: Cơm gà Hội An is a Hội An-style chicken rice order, so ask for less chili if the shredded chicken salad looks fiery. Extra herbs and side broth are good local-feeling additions.
worthKnowing: The Hội An name matters because the rice, shredded chicken, herbs, and chili-lime onion mixture belong to the old-town chicken-rice style. It should taste brighter and more fragrant than plain chicken over rice.
goodToKnow: This is not plain chicken on rice. The rice, herbs, and chili-lime onion mixture are what make it taste like Hội An.
